summary: Wrapped PostgresNarrationCache's get and set so psycopg.OperationalError is logged once and treated as a miss (get) or a no-op (set). Both verdict routes now return 200 with cached=false during an outage. Three new tests cover get, set and both; the sabotage turned the get tests red as expected.

tests_run.command: sabotage: re-raise in the get wrapper; uv run pytest -q tests/test_persona_cache_outage.py
tests_run.detail: the 2 get tests red; restored, cmp clean

tests_run.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

brief_defects: RUBRIC named tests/test_persona_cache.py as the existing cache suite to extend; it only exercises the in-memory fake, so the outage tests went in a new file.

findings.summary: PostgresNarrationCache opens a new psycopg connection on every get and set; there is no pool.
findings.evidence: psycopg.connect(self._dsn) inside both get() and set()
